columns.name: Bill Date
columns.notes: Excel date at midnight, never text; no time of day. First line of a bill only in layout sales-bill-line-25; every line in sales-bill-line-25-repeat.

columns.name: Bill No
columns.meaning: Bill number: financial year, store code and serial, as YY-YY/CODE/n.
columns.notes: Serial starts at 1 on 1 April and has no gaps in the full-period files. First line only in sales-bill-line-25; every line in sales-bill-line-25-repeat.

columns.name: Customer
columns.meaning: Customer name keyed at the counter; CASH for a walk-in. Personal data.
columns.notes: First line of a bill only. CASH is common. MANUAL BILL UPDATE on 30 bills in the Vaishnavi FY 2025-26 file. One cell holds the formula error #NAME? (bill 26-27/JSL/199).

columns.name: Phone
columns.notes: First line only. Held as a number, so a leading zero cannot survive. Blank on about half the bills; 9-digit and 11-digit values seen; 0 seen.

columns.name: Item
columns.meaning: Item type, for example SHIRT, JEANS, CARRY BAG.
columns.notes: Blank on a few lines (5 and 7 in the two Vaishnavi Deoghar files); those lines carry NA in other attribute columns.

columns.name: Brand
columns.meaning: Brand name, or a brand or division code such as LP, LY, LR, VH, VS, VF, AS, AL.
columns.notes: Names and codes mix. Carry bags carry the store's own name as brand.

columns.name: Color
columns.meaning: Holds PREMIUM, MEDIUM, ECONOMY or ASSO. instead of a colour on 99% of lines; a real colour name on a few.
columns.notes: 26,022 of 26,195 lines in Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx hold one of these tags. Staff tag goods with no clear colour or classification this way, mostly non-brand goods (product owner, 4 Oct 2026). How the product handles these tags is OPEN for the product owner.

columns.name: Size
columns.meaning: Size as keyed: number, letters, FREE SIZE, FS, kids age, pack or measure.
columns.notes: Numbers are stored as numbers, letters as text.

columns.name: Design No
columns.meaning: Style or design code as keyed by the store.
columns.notes: Some values become dates in Excel (75 cells in Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx; the same cell reads 2513-01-05 in one export and 2513-05-01 in another).

columns.name: Barcode
columns.notes: All-digit values are numbers, alphanumeric values are text. Classes seen: 7-digit in-house, 13-digit EAN, other 5 to 15 digit codes.

columns.name: SalesMan
columns.meaning: Salesperson name for the line. Personal data.
columns.notes: Line level; can differ within a bill. Blank on 30% to 45% of lines in the Jainsons Hazaribagh exports.

columns.name: Sub Category
columns.meaning: Category word or code of the bill's first line item, printed on the first line of a bill only.
columns.notes: Words (CASUAL WEAR) and codes (USM, UTP) mix. Blank on continuation lines.

columns.name: Gender
columns.meaning: Gender or kids group as keyed.
columns.notes: 12 spellings in Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx (for example KIDSM, KIDS, FEAMAL).

columns.name: Fit
columns.meaning: Fit as keyed. Also holds the codes LM, MM, VLM, HM and product words.
columns.notes: Some values end in a non-breaking space (182 lines in Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx).

columns.name: season
columns.meaning: Season label as keyed. The header is lower case here, upper case in stock layouts.
columns.notes: Several formats (see data-quality note). In Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx 597 cells are real dates and 267 are text dd-mm-yyyy.

columns.name: Qty
columns.meaning: Signed quantity of the line. Negative on a return or exchange line.
columns.notes: A returned item is a negative line inside a bill; no link to the original bill.

columns.name: Rate
columns.meaning: Sale-time MRP per unit. Qty x Rate = Gross Amt on every line. Not cost.
columns.notes: The text NaN on 1 line (Vaishnavi FY 2025-26) and 5 lines (Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx); 2 lines hold a half rupee.

columns.name: Disc%
columns.notes: 0 on many lines that carry a rupee Disc Amt (1,308 of 26,195 lines in Sales_Hazaribagh.xlsx). 100 on free-gift and carry-bag lines. On a few lines it disagrees with Disc Amt / Gross Amt.

columns.name: Disc Amt
columns.meaning: Rupee discount. Negative on sale lines, positive on return lines.

columns.name: Net Amount
columns.meaning: Gross Amt + Disc Amt: line value after discount.
columns.notes: Paise kept (two decimals). One cell holds a space (text).

columns.name: Bill Amount
columns.meaning: Bill total in whole rupees, on the first line of the bill only.
columns.notes: Equals Cash + Card + Credit on every bill. Equals the sum of the bill's Net Amount rounded half up on almost every bill; 19 of 5,383 bills in the Vaishnavi FY 2025-26 file differ by more than 1 rupee.

columns.name: Cash
columns.meaning: Cash part of the bill. First line only.

columns.name: Card
columns.meaning: Card part of the bill. First line only.
columns.notes: Whether UPI is inside Card is not stated; there is no UPI column.

columns.name: Credit
columns.meaning: Credit part of the bill. First line only.
columns.notes: 0 on every bill in every file seen.

row_meaning: One bill line: one barcode and quantity on one bill. Bill-level fields sit on the first line of the bill; continuation lines leave them blank.
total_rows: Most files end with a total row (Qty, Gross Amt, Disc Amt, Net Amount, Bill Amount, Cash, Card; Credit left blank), then a row with the label SALES RETURN in the Customer column and nothing else, a blank row, and the total row again. The Vaishnavi FY 2025-26 file has no total row. Files cut down by brand (AS-DEO sheets, LP HZB sheet) have none.
quirks: Header starts in column B; column A is empty.
Bill-level fields on the first line only: Bill Date, Bill No, Customer, Phone, Sub Category, Bill Amount, Cash, Card, Credit.
A return is a negative-quantity line inside a normal bill (an exchange); no link to the original bill. 326 of 327 bills with a return line also carry a sale line (Vaishnavi FY 2025-26).
Carry bags are sold as items (CARRY BAG) at a few rupees with Disc% 100.
Free gifts are lines with Disc% 100 and an ordinary item.
Disc% is 0 on many lines that carry a rupee Disc Amt.
Disc Amt is negative on sale lines and positive on return lines.
Brand-cut files (AS-DEO sheets) start with lines that have no bill header (3 and 4 lines) and Bill Amount and tenders belong to the whole bill, so they do not add up to the lines.
No tax, HSN, time of day, UPI column, cost or billing device.
Dates are real dates; season and Design No can be turned into dates by Excel.
